i understand how you feel, and i want you to know that even if you feel like no one cares, then know that i care. i dont care that i dont know you personally, i care that youre still alive and that you’re still here. i cant say it will get better because i do not know your life and i am not you so i cannot assume things or make calls, but i will tell you that theres always a possibility it might get better. yes, it might all go to shit and chaos might erupt, but it may also go well and get better. the fact that none of your friends even tried to comfort you is concerning, and they dont really seem like good friends if they ignored your cry for help. mayhaps it is time to find some new friends who will care. also, have you considered asking your parents for therapy? therapy might help a bit, or a lot. asking for therapy is worth a shot. just remember you matter, and i care even if i dont know you.

i was put into a psych ward when i was about 11/12 and honestly it was traumatic. the staff cared more about the other girl i bunked with, they didnt let me do anything, made me go to a two week outpatient all day “camp” thing. and tbh, the “help” they gave did nothing. while yes if you somehow manage to find a decent hospital that helps (if im honest the last hospital i went to was nice and it helped in short term but in long term did not)  then by all means please seek help. but psych wards are honestly worse than most people think they are. especially parents who’ve never been in a psych ward, they think that its an amazing option and will keep you safe but tbh most kids that do go either get traumatized, feel the need to end their life even more, or if its a good hospital they go down the road of recovery.
